# 1.1.1 Non-text Content

Generated by `npm run build` from the feature files in `src/components/` and the step definitions in `src/tests/_shared-steps/`. Edit those, not this file.

Level A. [Understanding 1.1.1 Non-text Content on w3.org](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/non-text-content.html).

Scenarios: automatic.

## Setup

- [`Given I load the sample "<input-url>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/1-Given/samples-load.js) — Loads a sample to test from a web URL.
- [`When I inspect "<selector>" in the DOM`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-inspected.js) — Checks element exists in the DOM, regardless of visibility on the page.
- [`When I inspect "<selector>" in the Accessibility Tree`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-inspected.js) — Checks an element exists in the accessibility tree.
- [`When I view the rendered "<selector>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-viewed.js) — Checks an element is visibly rendered on the page.
- [`When I click on "<selector>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/mouse-events-occur.js) — Clicks an element with the primary mouse button

## Assertions

- [`Then it should have the attribute "<attribute>" with the value "<value>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element has a particular attribute and value.
- [`Then its accessible name should be "<accessible-name>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks the accessible name matches a given string.
- [`Then any icon should have a text description, or be hidden from assistive technologies`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/image-checks.js) — Automatically checks each icon is hidden from assistive technologies when a text label exists, or has a text description when it doesn't. Note: An icon which carries its own description also records a manual checklist, so a person can judge the wording.
- [`Then it should have an accessible name`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element just has an accessible name.
- [`Then it should contain the text "<text>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element's text includes some expected text, including text which is visually hidden.

## Example

```gherkin
Background:
  Given I load the sample "http://localhost:8081/accordion/examples/default"

@1.1.1 @a @automatic
Rule: 1.1.1 Non-text Content, Level A
  Scenario: The icon is hidden from screen readers, because the trigger has a visible text label
    When I inspect ".tl-accordion__section:nth-of-type(1) > button svg" in the DOM
    Then it should have the attribute "aria-hidden" with the value "true"
    When I inspect ".tl-accordion__section:nth-of-type(1) > button" in the Accessibility Tree
    Then its accessible name should be "What is an accessibility audit?"
```
